name: maubot
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: A plugin-based bot system for Matrix, managed in its own web interface. Bots, plugins and their data are kept in SQLite.
startup: v=$(cat .maubot-version); h=$( (python3 --version; echo "$v") | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat .venv/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing maubot $v"; rm -rf .venv; python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check "maubot==$v" && echo "$h" > .venv/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; .venv/bin/python .raptor-config.py || exit 1; exec .venv/bin/python -m maubot -c config.yaml

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# maubot: picks the chosen maubot version from PyPI and writes the helper
# that makes its first config.yaml. maubot itself is installed from PyPI
# when the server starts, for the Python version it runs. The settings
# (config.yaml), the database, plugins and logs are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
json=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://pypi.org/pypi/maubot/json) || fail "PyPI can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    version=$(jq -r .info.version <<<"$json")
else
    version="${want#v}"
    jq -e --arg v "$version" '.releases[$v] | length > 0' <<<"$json" >/dev/null ||
        fail "maubot has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.6.0, then reinstall."
fi
echo "$version" > .maubot-version
mkdir -p plugins trash logs

# Run at every start with maubot's Python: makes config.yaml from maubot's
# own example the first time (a random encryption key, the admin account,
# logs in logs/ at INFO), and sets the public address.
cat > .raptor-config.py <<'PY'
import os, secrets, sys
from importlib.resources import files
from ruamel.yaml import YAML

yaml = YAML()
yaml.preserve_quotes = True
first = not os.path.exists("config.yaml")
if first:
    cfg = yaml.load(files("maubot").joinpath("example-config.yaml").read_text())
    cfg["crypto_db_pickle_key"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    cfg["logging"]["handlers"]["file"]["filename"] = "./logs/maubot.log"
    for name in ("maubot", "mau"):
        cfg["logging"]["loggers"][name]["level"] = "INFO"
    cfg["logging"]["root"]["level"] = "INFO"
    user = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USER") or "admin"
    password = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD") or ""
    if not password:
        password = secrets.token_urlsafe(18)
        fd = os.open("admin-password.txt", os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o600)
        os.write(fd, (password + "\n").encode())
        os.close(fd)
        print(f"Admin password is empty, so the account {user} has the password in admin-password.txt.")
    # maubot replaces the plain password with a bcrypt hash when it starts.
    cfg["admins"][user] = password
else:
    cfg = yaml.load(open("config.yaml"))
url = os.environ.get("PUBLIC_URL") or ""
if not url:
    ip = os.environ.get("SERVER_IP") or ""
    url = "http://%s:%s" % ("localhost" if ip in ("", "0.0.0.0") else ip, os.environ.get("SERVER_PORT", "29316"))
cfg["server"]["hostname"] = "0.0.0.0"
cfg["server"]["port"] = int(os.environ.get("SERVER_PORT", "29316"))
cfg["server"]["public_url"] = url.rstrip("/")
with open("config.yaml.new", "w") as f:
    yaml.dump(cfg, f)
os.replace("config.yaml.new", "config.yaml")
if first:
    print("Wrote a first config.yaml.")
PY
echo "Selected maubot $version (it's installed from PyPI when the server starts)."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The maubot version to install, such as 0.6.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: The account for maubot's web interface, made at the first start.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: That account's password, used only at the first start. Leave it empty to use a random one, saved in admin-password.txt.

variables.name: Address
variables.description: The public address of maubot, starting with http or https. Empty uses the server's IP and port.
